# Empowered DLD

> A practical, story-led support system for children with Developmental Language Disorder and the parents, educators, and SLPs who support them.

Empowered DLD is a Canadian, story-led education and resource brand focused on Developmental Language Disorder (DLD). We create practical, representation-forward tools for children with DLD and the adults who support them, including parents, educators, speech-language pathologists (SLPs), therapists, and school communities.

Founded by Jinean Whitley, a Speech-Language Pathologist, and Camesha Russell, an elementary educator, Empowered DLD helps families, educators, and SLPs turn DLD awareness into practical support. Through children's books, classroom tools, parent resources, animated podcast episodes, and upcoming music, we help children understand their brains, build self-advocacy, and feel seen in everyday moments. Our work is children-first and lifespan-aware. We focus on supporting children today while recognizing that DLD is lifelong.

DLD is one of the most common developmental conditions affecting roughly 1 in 14 people (Norbury et al., 2016) yet remains widely under-recognized. Our mission is to help children with DLD feel seen and to give the adults around them clear, practical tools they can use at home, in therapy, and in the classroom.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://empowereddld.com/): Story-led books, resources, and training for children with DLD and the adults who support them.
- [Why Empowered DLD](https://empowereddld.com/why-empowered-dld): How Empowered DLD is different: story-led, practical, children-first, lifespan-aware, built by an SLP and an elementary educator.
- [About DLD](https://empowereddld.com/about-dld): What Developmental Language Disorder is, how common it is, signs to look for, and why it matters across the lifespan.
- [Who We Serve](https://empowereddld.com/who-we-serve): Pathways for parents, therapists, educators, and organizations.
- [For Parents](https://empowereddld.com/for-parents): Family-focused guidance, advocacy tools, and home strategies.
- [For Therapists](https://empowereddld.com/for-therapists): Clinical resources, IEP support, and professional development for SLPs.
- [For Educators](https://empowereddld.com/for-educators): Classroom strategies, accommodations, and DLD awareness materials for teachers.
- [For Organizations](https://empowereddld.com/for-organizations): Partnership packages, bulk orders, and implementation support for schools, clinics, and districts.

## Resources

- [Resource library](https://empowereddld.com/resources): Hub for blog posts, free course, podcasts, and downloadable tools.
- [Blog](https://empowereddld.com/resources/blog): Long-form articles on DLD identification, intervention, advocacy, and research.
- [Free DLD course](https://empowereddld.com/resources/free-course): Self-paced introduction to Developmental Language Disorder.
- [Podcasts](https://empowereddld.com/resources/podcasts): Conversations with researchers, clinicians, and families.
- [Downloadable tools](https://empowereddld.com/resources/downloadables): Checklists, handouts, and worksheets.
- [Language Impact Checklist](https://empowereddld.com/resources/language-impact-checklist): Screening tool to help families and educators flag possible language concerns.
